headline: Carney says he had 'good conversation' with Trump regarding trade
summary: The stories that stayed in the briefing most this week: Carney says he had 'good conversation' with Trump regarding trade; Russian strikes cut power to thousands in Ukraine as Kherson ceasefire ends; Iran says no Hormuz reopening until U.S. meets its seven conditions.

top.headline: Carney says he had 'good conversation' with Trump regarding trade
top.what: Carney said the conversation built on recent discussions about the outlines of a deal that would create jobs, lower costs for families and protect Canada's languages, culture and sovereignty.
top.why: In the briefing on 5 of the last 7 days.

top.headline: Russian strikes cut power to thousands in Ukraine as Kherson ceasefire ends
top.what: A rare humanitarian ceasefire allowed civilians to evacuate the Russian-occupied city of Oleshky.
top.why: In the briefing on 5 of the last 7 days.

top.headline: Iran says no Hormuz reopening until U.S. meets its seven conditions
top.what: Iran's security chief says Tehran has not yet replied to a U.S. letter and will keep the Strait of Hormuz shut and stay out of talks until Washington accepts its terms.
top.why: In the briefing on 4 of the last 7 days.

top.headline: Economy stalls in August, two days after Bank of Canada's hike
top.what: Statistics Canada says the economy was flat in August and probably shrank 0.1% in September, a weak backdrop for the Bank of Canada's first rate increase since 2023.
top.why: In the briefing on 4 of the last 7 days.

top.headline: Ontario deficit grows to $16.9 billion; balance pushed to 2029-30
top.what: Finance Minister Peter Bethlenfalvy's fall update raised this year's deficit by more than $3 billion and delayed a balanced budget by a year as the trade war slows growth.
top.why: In the briefing on 4 of the last 7 days.

top.headline: Nearly 45 million votes cast as midterms enter final weekend
top.what: With Election Day on Tuesday, Democrats lead national polls for the House while Senate control rests on a handful of toss-up races.
top.why: In the briefing on 4 of the last 7 days.

top.headline: U.S. economy grows 3.4% in third quarter as inflation cools
top.what: The U.S. economy expanded at a 3.4% annual rate from July to September, faster than the spring, while a key inflation gauge eased.
top.why: In the briefing on 4 of the last 7 days.

top.headline: Final count leaves Netanyahu's bloc at 53 seats, short of a majority
top.what: Israel faces weeks of coalition talks after final results gave neither Netanyahu's bloc nor Gadi Eisenkot's a 61-seat majority, and Likud claimed the vote was stolen.
top.why: In the briefing on 4 of the last 7 days.
